# 🗑️ **TossToTrash** 🚀

**TossToTrash** is a high-performance, **Server-Side ONLY** utility designed for **Minecraft 1.21.x, 26.1.x, and 26.2.x**. It provides a sleek, professional solution for server administrators looking to annihilate entity lag and keep their worlds pristine—without forcing players to download a single file! 🔌✨

### Supported Versions

| Version | Java | Status |
|---------|------|--------|
| 1.21.x | 21 | ✅ Full support |
| 26.1.x | 25 | ✅ Full support |
| 26.2.x | 25 | ✅ Full support |

---

### 🛠️ **Purpose & Function**
The core mission of this project is to replace the messy, lag-inducing method of "dropping" items with a **Digital Disposal System**. 🌌

- **Stop the Clutter:** Instead of tossing unwanted blocks on the ground—which creates physical entities that drain server resources and tank your TPS—players can now use the `/trash` command. 🧹
- **Instant Void:** This opens a private, 27-slot virtual interface where items are instantly and permanently deleted the moment the UI is closed. 💨🔥

---

### ✨ **Key Features**
- 🚀 **Lag Annihilator:** Stops the buildup of item entities at spawns, mob grinders, and community farms dead in their tracks.
- 📡 **100% Server-Side:** No client-side installation is required! Vanilla players can join and use the trash bin immediately. 🍦
- 🛡️ **Safe & Secure:** Uses a familiar **9x3 chest-style UI** so players can double-check their items before closing the bin.
- ⚖️ **Ultra-Lightweight:** Optimized with clean Fabric code to ensure a near-zero footprint on your server's CPU. 🧠
- 🔌 **Plug & Play:** Simply drop the JAR into your server's mod folder and you're ready to clean up!
- 🧹 **Zero Dependencies:** No Fabric API, no Architectury, no Forge — just Fabric Loader and raw Mixins.

---

### 🎮 **How to Use**
- **Step 1:** Type `/trash` in your chat. 💬
- **Step 2:** Drag all your unwanted Cobblestone, Rotten Flesh, or Dirt into the bin. 📦
- **Step 3:** Close the menu. ❌
- **Step 4:** **Poof!** Your items are gone, and your server stays fast. ⚡

---

> *This mod is built for administrators who value a clean world and high performance. Developed for the community to provide a faster, smoother survival experience.* 🌍💎
